prompt_en: Create an ultra-realistic miniature city portrait in a vertical 9:16 composition. A beautiful young woman sits behind a detailed tabletop-scale miniature of London, leaning forward with both forearms crossed gently on the table, wearing a crisp white long-sleeve blouse with a buttoned collar. She has long, glossy chestnut-brown wavy hair parted in the center, warm medium skin, and a calm elegant studio-portrait pose. Add the River Thames winding through the foreground with small boats, bridges, embankments, trees, streets, tiny cars, buses, buildings, warm city lights, and realistic reflections on the water. Use cinematic shallow depth of field: the woman’s upper body and hair are sharp, the miniature foreground is richly detailed, and the far background softly fades. Lighting is soft studio lighting with gentle highlights on the white blouse and warm rim light on the hair. Background is a dark navy-blue seamless studio backdrop. Make the scale feel magical and surreal, as if the woman is a giant carefully posed behind a hyper-detailed miniature London. Ultra-realistic photography, high detail, natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, premium editorial portrait quality, no text, no watermark, no distorted architecture.\

title: 月相月饼品牌主视觉板

categories: 产品营销,海报 / 传单,摄影,产品,美食 / 饮品,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a premium brand hero board for a modern Oriental mooncake dessert gift brand named 望月甜造, with the English subtitle MOONLIGHT SWEET ATELIER, inspired by moon phases, quiet moonlight, tea culture, and luxury Mid-Autumn gifting.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 commercial poster, dark navy and warm gold palette, elegant high-end food photography blended with refined graphic design. Use cinematic low-key lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, soft moon glow, and a luxurious editorial product-advertising composition.

Layout: Top-left typography block, large Chinese brand title in refined serif calligraphy, English subtitle beneath it, then the slogan 把月光，做成一份甜。. Add a small line of descriptive copy below: “现代东方月相甜点品牌商品化提案”. Include exactly 4 small circular feature badges under the copy, labeled: 1) “月相灵感”, 2) “低糖轻奢”, 3) “茶配甜点”, 4) “中秋限定”. Put a tiny top label reading “品牌主视觉 / BRAND HERO BOARD”. Add a thin footer band at the bottom with small brand-system text and a round seal logo.

Main scene: On a dark marble tabletop, show an open luxury mooncake gift box in deep midnight blue with gold edging. Inside the box are exactly 6 round mooncakes in individual square compartments: 1 black mooncake with gold flakes, 1 pale cream mooncake with a crescent motif, 1 golden yellow mooncake, 1 ivory mooncake, 1 dark brown mooncake, and 1 light beige mooncake with subtle marbling. Each mooncake should look like a refined modern dessert rather than a traditional red-gold pastry.

Packaging details: Behind the open box, place the upright matching gift box lid in navy leather-like texture with gold speckled star dust, five moon phase symbols across the front, the brand name 望月甜造, and the English subtitle below. Add a hanging oval tag and tassel on the right side of the box, with the text “月见定”.

Foreground food details: In front of the box, place exactly 2 cut mooncake pieces on a dark stone serving plate: 1 black mooncake half with glossy dark filling and 1 golden mooncake half with flowing caramel-colored filling. Add a slim gold dessert fork beside them and a tiny gold rabbit figurine nearby.

Surrounding props: Include exactly 5 supporting table props: 1 glass teapot filled with amber tea on the left, 1 white round plate partially visible at the far left, 1 dark lidded teacup on a wooden saucer to the right, 1 small white teacup with tea at the bottom right, and 1 navy invitation card with moon phase graphics and gold lettering near the cup. In the background, show a large blurred full moon and soft silhouetted branches, creating a poetic night garden atmosphere.

Visual style: Premium Chinese luxury dessert branding, dark navy, champagne gold, warm amber highlights, realistic product photography, delicate gold foil, marble texture, soft reflections, elegant serif typography, poetic Mid-Autumn mood. Avoid cartoon styling, avoid bright red traditional packaging, avoid clutter, keep the design clean and sale-ready.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic anime fighting-game character poster for Yuri Sakazaki, showing two dynamic depictions of the same young female martial artist in a gritty urban battle scene.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape composition, high-resolution promotional key art, dark cinematic lighting, sharp anime rendering, glossy highlights, heavy motion effects.

Layout: Place the main action figure on the left, leaping diagonally forward with one knee raised and one fist clenched, occupying about half the image. Place a second depiction of the same character on the right in a school-uniform fighting pose, turned partly away, with one open palm thrust toward the viewer; her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. Center the typography vertically between the two figures, layered over black-and-blue paint strokes and red slash effects.

Discrete visible character elements: exactly 2 character depictions: 1) left combat outfit version, airborne kick pose; 2) right school-uniform version, defensive open-palm pose with blurred face.

Subject details: The character has brown hair in short bob-length layers with a side braid, red headband, red hair ribbons, expressive anime eyes on the left figure, athletic build, confident smile, and martial-arts energy. Left outfit: white sleeveless gi-style top with dark trim, brown belt, deep purple leggings, purple fingerless gloves, red-orange high-top sneakers with white laces, and a red headband. Right outfit: white sailor-style school blouse with navy collar, navy pleated skirt, yellow fingerless glove on the forward hand, red scarf or ribbon tied near the braid, and a blue-toned shadowed lower half.

Background: Nighttime city skyline with tall skyscrapers, lit windows, tilted perspective, black asphalt-like texture, exploding white debris, rain-like sparks, blue energy streaks, red paint splatters, and diagonal speed lines. Use a gritty black, navy, red, and white palette with high contrast and metallic grunge texture.

Text content: Include large distressed Japanese brush-calligraphy text in the center reading 極限流 空手. Add smaller Japanese text reading ユリ・サカザキ. Add small red English text near the bottom center reading YURI SAKAZAKI. In the upper right background, include faint oversized weathered letters spelling “YURI.”

Typography style: White cracked stone brush lettering with rough edges, black shadows, red underline slashes, and dramatic layered depth; the English name should be narrow uppercase serif or condensed lettering in red.

Constraints: Keep exactly 2 character depictions, no extra characters, no watermark, no logos besides the specified name text, preserve the rectangular face blur on the right figure, make the pose energetic and poster-like.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a photorealistic cinematic nighttime scene of Times Square in New York, centered on two enormous adjacent digital billboards above a busy wet street.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape image, street-level perspective, realistic lens compression, high dynamic range, glossy rain-soaked pavement reflecting neon lights, deep blue evening sky between skyscrapers.

Main layout: The composition has exactly 2 dominant central billboards. Billboard 1 on the left is a movie-poster-style ad for THE CHASE, with the smaller actor/name text KAIRO above the title. It shows a stylish faceless male action hero in a long black coat and dark suit, standing on a rooftop at sunset with an orange city skyline behind him; the coat flares in the wind, and small fake production-credit text runs along the bottom. Billboard 2 on the right is a dark, mostly empty premium ad screen showing a blurred high-speed night city road with blue-black tones, subtle thin geometric HUD-like corner lines, and a white Disney logo near the lower-left area.

Surrounding visible signage: Include exactly 6 notable secondary advertising/sign elements around the central billboards: a large M&M's World sign on the left, a vertical red TKTS sign near the left-center stairs, a vertical TIMES SQUARE-style sign on a building between the main billboards and the right tower, a red Coca-Cola bottle billboard on the far right, a white M&M's sign above it, and a bright blue rectangular billboard at the upper-right corner.

Street and crowd details: Show a dense crowd of pedestrians and tourists gathered along sidewalks and plaza edges, some holding phones toward the billboards. Include exactly 4 prominent moving vehicles in the foreground street: two yellow taxis, one dark sedan, and one blurred vehicle streak, all with motion blur and headlight flares. Red TKTS stairs and a small statue silhouette appear beneath the left billboard.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic commercial photography mixed with blockbuster advertising, sharp architecture, vivid neon reflections, cinematic contrast, realistic Times Square scale, no cartoon styling.

Constraints: Keep the left poster title large and readable, preserve the faceless censored-looking face on the poster character, do not add extra central billboards, do not add watermarks, and avoid legible long blocks of text other than the specified ad words.\

Waiting for laundry at night

Character and Expression:
A 20-year-old woman. Slender model figure, healthy and feminine silhouette. Refined and cute facial features, round small face, natural double eyelids, clear eyes, small nose, soft mouth. Dark brown shoulder-length hair with loose outward flips and light waves, transparent bangs. Makeup is clear Japanese-style, light rose blush, pink-beige lips, subtle eye bags, long thin lashes. Expression is quiet with a slight smile, looking directly at the camera.

Clothing and Pose:
Upper body wearing only a khaki beige fine-rib camisole. Lower body in a black high-waisted hip-hugging mini skirt, black sheer stockings, black short boots. Small earrings and a thin necklace. Right shoulder and back leaning lightly against the washing machine on the right, hips tilted slightly. Her right hand pinches a laundry card and hangs naturally by the side of the skirt. Her left hand is relaxed by her thigh. Legs lightly crossed, weight on the right leg. Natural depiction of clothing wrinkles, shoulder straps, fingers, and feet touching the ground.

Background and Lighting:
Laundromat at night. Stacked drum-type washing machines on the right, detergent vending machine and old signs in the back, laundry basket on the floor. Black door frames or walls in the left and right foreground are heavily blurred to create a voyeuristic, peeking-through-a-gap space. Fluorescent ceiling lights from the upper left hit at an angle, softly illuminating the face, collarbones, shoulders, and camisole texture. Shadows fall to the bottom right and background. Weak reflections on the metal surfaces of the machines, pale blue small lights from the vending machine. Japanese text in the background as natural environmental text, details not too legible.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Full-body portrait. Person slightly to the right of center, full body occupies about 70% of the screen. Boldly hide sides with black vertical frames in the foreground, creating a narrow visual path in the center. Camera height slightly lower than chest level, light eye-level shot. Compression feel like a medium telephoto lens, background shallowly blurred. Focus on eyes, feet and machines in the back slightly softened.

Texture and Style:
Realistic photographic style. Night low-light snapshot, 35mm film-like grain, slightly warm fluorescent lights, deep shadows, skin left with natural texture without over-polishing. Tonal consistency with beige, black, muted green, and pale blue mechanical light. Not like a magazine photo, but a quiet documentary feel of a candid shot.

Unnatural face or gaze, overly large eyes, too sharp chin, extra or missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact with card, floating feet, unnatural gravity, distorted washing machine doors, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-looking skin, overexposure, unnecessary people, legible brand logos, garbled text, watermarks, excessive AI feel.\

Main subject: One central full-body 3D character, Sun Wukong, leaping toward the viewer from a rocky mountain path. He wears ornate red-and-gold battle armor with engraved shoulder plates, layered scale skirt armor, red cloth ribbons, tiger-fur waist accents, decorated bracers and boots. His golden-brown monkey hair rises upward like a flaming mane. His face is covered by a centered opaque brown square censor block. His right arm thrusts a huge golden staff directly toward the camera, making the staff extremely foreshortened and breaking the poster frame; the staff dominates the left foreground and is motion-blurred at the tip. His left arm extends backward for balance, with red scarf fabric whipping in the wind.

Environment: A vast mythic mountain landscape with jagged cliffs on both sides, a winding rocky path below, distant temples and pavilions built on peaks, storm clouds split by heavenly sunlight, flying debris, mist, and radiant golden spell lines connecting scenes across the poster.

Background story vignettes: Include exactly 4 small narrative scenes around the main figure: 1) upper left, a distant sacred mountain temple on a cliff; 2) upper right, a floating celestial palace scene with two flying immortal figures inside a glowing rectangular magical frame; 3) lower left, a monk-like Tang Sanzang figure standing on the path among mist and followers; 4) mid-to-lower right, a small warrior or pilgrim figure walking through the mountain trail near glowing spell lines.

Chinese poster text: Add exactly 6 vertical or calligraphic text groups in gold. Preserve these visible Chinese titles: 1) large bottom-left brush calligraphy title 「孙悟空」; 2) upper-left vertical label 「花果山」; 3) upper-right vertical label 「大闹天宫」; 4) mid-right vertical label 「五行山下」; 5) lower-right vertical label 「降妖除魔」; 6) lower-left vertical label 「西天取经」. Add tiny supporting Chinese subtext beside each label, but keep it decorative and secondary. Include a small red seal stamp near the large title and a small tagline at the bottom reading 「齐天大圣·斗战之心」.

Composition: The staff must protrude aggressively from the center-left foreground toward the viewer; the main body should fill the middle of the poster; the four background vignettes should remain smaller and atmospheric. Use golden linework and faint geometric frames to guide the eye around the poster.

Style: Hyper-realistic 3D render mixed with Chinese fantasy concept art, ornate armor detail, cinematic lighting, IMAX poster scale, dynamic action, dust clouds, glowing particles, dramatic clouds, sharp central character, soft atmospheric background.

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a single ultra-wide cinematic anime storyboard sheet for a high-impact hand-to-hand battle scene, designed as black-and-white visual reference art.

Canvas: 21:9 horizontal canvas, clean white background, thin black outer border, divided into exactly 12 rectangular storyboard panels arranged in a 3-row by 4-column grid with narrow white gutters and thin black panel borders.

Visual style: High-contrast monochrome ink art, characters mostly rendered as solid black silhouettes with minimal white rim highlights, sharp manga/anime speed lines, impact bursts, ink splatter, ground scrape marks, and exaggerated cinematic camera angles. No grayscale shading, no color, no speech bubbles, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

Characters: Two fighters only. Fighter A is a tall, extremely muscular male silhouette with spiky hair, sleeveless combat outfit, gloves, loose pants, and heavy boots. Fighter B is a smaller athletic male silhouette with spiky hair, fitted combat clothes, gloves, and boots. Keep both characters as dark silhouettes throughout, with strong readable poses.

Panel layout and action beats: Include exactly 12 panels, left to right, top to bottom:
1. Wide establishing standoff: the large fighter stands powerfully on the left, the smaller fighter squares up on the right, both grounded on rough black brush shadows.
2. Dynamic low-angle charge: the large fighter lunges forward toward camera, fist cocked, strong radial speed lines behind him.
3. Close-up impact punch: the large fighter’s fist smashes into the smaller fighter’s face or upper body, with a bright white impact starburst.
4. Side view knockback: the smaller fighter is thrown backward to the right while the large fighter follows through in a running strike pose.
5. Mid-shot kick impact: the large fighter drives a heavy kick or knee into the smaller fighter, who bends forward from the blow, with burst lines at the torso.
6. Tight close combat: the large fighter grabs or body-checks the opponent at close range, faces close, strong white impact flash between their bodies.
7. Airborne launch: the smaller fighter flies diagonally across an otherwise open white panel, debris and ground slash marks trailing from the launch point.
8. Running punch chase: the large fighter dashes in from the left and lands another straight punch on the opponent at the right edge, with horizontal speed streaks.
9. Ground slam: the large fighter crouches over the opponent and drives him into the ground, huge black splash-like impact lines radiating upward.
10. Downed opponent strike: the smaller fighter lies on the ground while the large fighter stands over him and punches downward, with a compact impact burst.
11. Final power punch: dramatic perspective shot from behind the large fighter as he throws a massive punch into the opponent, surrounded by dense speed lines and impact shards.
12. Aftermath: the large fighter stands tall and victorious on the left; the smaller fighter kneels or collapses on the right with one hand on the ground, defeated.

Constraints: Use 21:9; keep exactly 12 panels and exactly two fighters; make the action read clearly as one continuous brutal anime battle sequence; preserve the clean storyboard-sheet composition; avoid extra characters, weapons, text, color, gore, or background scenery beyond speed lines and ground marks.\

prompt_en:
Describe the person in the reference image at the rooftop observation deck of a high-rise commercial building overlooking the Shibuya Scramble Crossing directly below and in front, capturing the moment they are taking a selfie with a smartphone. This is a selfie-style composition captured by a close-range third-person camera, not the actual phone screen view.

Maintain the facial features, eyes, hairstyle, hair color, age, and the color, shape, material, and decoration of the outfit from the reference image to ensure consistency. Do not inherit the original background, lighting, composition, or pose.

Make the person the sole focus in a stable 3/4 body shot from the face to around the thighs. Prioritize the reproduction of the face, upper body, outfit, smartphone, and background over showing the full body.

The person stands on a safe rooftop deck, extending one arm forward holding the smartphone and looking naturally at the screen. The smartphone should appear somewhat large in the foreground without obscuring the face or outfit. Place the other arm naturally near the body.

Show a small portion of the rooftop floor and a transparent glass fence at the bottom or sides of the frame to clarify the location. The rooftop should occupy less than 10% of the screen. Avoid themes of floating, falling, or standing on dangerous edges.

The camera is slightly ahead and above the person, providing a diagonal high-angle view of Shibuya. Do not use a top-down view. Place the Scramble Crossing prominently below and behind the center of the person, showing wide crosswalks in multiple directions, the center of the intersection, and numerous pedestrians. Do not leave the center empty or sparse.

Surround the scene with high-density commercial buildings, curved glass, storefront facades, and large digital billboards, showing at least three screens. The screens should display vibrant abstract visuals in blue, cyan, red, magenta, and pink without readable text or real brand logos.

The time is a soft natural light afternoon. Roads are neutral gray, and crosswalks are clear white. Do not desaturate or whiten the background; maintain the colorful glamor of Shibuya through the crowds and digital reflections. Avoid overexposure, excessive HDR, sunsets, night views, fog, or blue tints. The person's face and outfit should be slightly clearer than the background.

Maintain the quality of realistic reference images, or the art style, lines, coloring, and texture of anime/illustration references. Do not convert between realism and anime. Avoid anatomical errors, distorted smartphones, or readable advertising text.\
